blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Replace the div with a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`: it is in the tab order, reacts to Enter and Space, and exposes the button role. A keyboard user pressing Tab never lands on the delete action and cannot delete a document; screen readers announce no control. WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text). The only content is `TrashIcon`, whose svg is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx:3), so a screen reader user reaching the control hears nothing, or just "button" once it becomes one, and cannot tell it deletes the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add an `alt`: the owner's name (e.g. `alt={ownerName}`, which needs a prop) since the avatar identifies the document's owner, or `alt=""` if the owner is named in text elsewhere. Without it, screen readers announce the image file name or URL instead of who owns the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The icon is 16 by 16 (src/components/icons.tsx:3) and the `icon-button` style is not in the change: check that the control is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (or spaced enough) and has a visible focus indicator once it is a button. WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 2.4.7 Focus Visible.
findings.title: Icon button target size and focus style not verifiable
